image_description: A man wearing a red jacket and blue cap is holding a large sturgeon fish horizontally. The background appears to be the white siding of a building or boat. The fish is gray with visible bony scutes along its side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is elongated and the mouth is clearly positioned on the underside (ventral), consistent with sturgeon anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Four distinct barbel structures are visible hanging down in front of the mouth area.
The snout tapers to a point at the anterior end of the fish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body is long, cylindrical, and tapers at both ends, fitting the fusiform description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony plates (scutes) are visible running longitudinally along the lateral line and dorsal area. No typical fish scales are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top of the fish is dark gray/brown, transitioning to a pale white/cream color on the belly.
The caudal fin is visibly asymmetrical, with the upper lobe extending further than the lower lobe, characteristic of heterocercal tails.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out look-alike primitive fish.
To verify the integrity of the scutes and ensure they are attached to the body rather than floating or melting into the skin.
To check for subtle texture inconsistencies in the fish skin and potential AI artifacts in the human subject's hands holding the fish.
To detect the human subject and provide bounding boxes for checking hand-fish interaction integrity.

focus_areas: Scute texture and attachment to body
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Verify if the scutes appear as distinct, hard structures or if they blend softly into the skin (a common AI artifact). Check if the barbels have a consistent thickness and origin point. Ensure the heterocercal tail structure is anatomically plausible and not just a distorted standard tail.
